items.title: The influence of visual restriction and lower-limb proprioception on walking capacity in children with and without upper motor neuron lesions.
items.summary: Gait stability depends on the integration of visual and proprioceptive feedback. Children with upper motor neuron (UMN) lesions often exhibit proprioceptive deficits; however, the interaction between these deficits and visual input during walking remains unclear. This study investigated the influence of visual restriction and lower-limb proprioceptive function on walking capacity in children with UMN lesions compared to typically developing (TD) peers. In this cross-sectional study, 42 children with UMN lesions and 49 TD peers completed the 10-Meter Walk Test under normal and reduced visual conditions. We calculated absolute and relative (reduced vision/normal vision) gait capacity metrics. Proprioception was assessed at the hip, knee, and ankle using joint movement sense (JMS), joint position sense (JPS), and dynamic position sense (DPS). Spearman correlations examined relationships between proprioception and gait capacity. Both groups walked slower and took shorter steps under reduced vision; however, children with UMN lesions exhibited larger changes (p < 0.001). In these children, proprioceptive modalities showed weak-to-moderate correlations with gait parameters that strengthened under visual restriction, a pattern observed in pooled analyses. JMS showed the strongest, though weak, correlation with relative walking speed. Joint-specific analyses showed the strongest correlations at the more affected ankle and the less affected hip in children with UMN lesions. Children with UMN lesions rely more on proprioceptive input for gait under reduced vision, with the less affected hip and more affected ankle possibly compensating for deficits. Interventions targeting proprioception may enhance walking performance under varying sensory conditions.

items.titleZh: 视觉限制与下肢本体感觉对上下运动神经元病变患儿步行能力的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究比较了42名上运动神经元病变患儿与49名典型发育儿童在正常和视觉受限条件下的步行能力。结果发现，视觉受限时两组步速和步幅均下降，但患儿组下降更明显；患儿组本体感觉与步态参数的相关性在视觉受限下增强，提示其更依赖本体感觉输入，且较少受影响的髋关节和更受影响的踝关节可能参与代偿。研究建议针对本体感觉的干预可能改善步行表现。
items.insight: 该研究揭示了上运动神经元病变患儿在视觉受限时对本体感觉的依赖增强，并初步定位了代偿关节（较少受影响的髋和更受影响的踝）。这对理解ALS等上运动神经元受累疾病中感觉-运动整合障碍及开发针对性康复策略具有参考价值，但需注意本研究对象为儿童上运动神经元病变（非ALS），且为横断面设计，不能推断因果。

aiRead.keyFinding: 上运动神经元病变患儿在视觉受限下步行能力下降更明显，且本体感觉与步态参数的相关性增强，提示其更依赖本体感觉输入，较少受影响的髋关节和更受影响的踝关节可能代偿。
aiRead.limitation: 横断面设计无法推断因果；研究对象为儿童上运动神经元病变而非ALS；样本量有限；相关性分析仅为弱至中度相关。
aiRead.watchNext: 未来可关注针对本体感觉的干预研究能否改善上运动神经元病变患者在不同感觉条件下的步行表现，以及该机制在ALS等成人上运动神经元疾病中的适用性。

items.abstractZh: 步态稳定性依赖于视觉与本体感觉反馈的整合。上运动神经元（UMN）病变患儿常存在本体感觉缺陷；然而，这些缺陷与视觉输入在步行中的交互作用尚不清楚。本研究探讨了视觉限制与下肢本体感觉功能对UMN病变患儿步行能力的影响，并与典型发育（TD）同龄人进行比较。在这项横断面研究中，42名UMN病变患儿和49名TD同龄人在正常和视觉受限条件下完成了10米步行测试。我们计算了绝对和相对（视觉受限/正常视觉）步态能力指标。本体感觉通过关节运动觉（JMS）、关节位置觉（JPS）和动态位置觉（DPS）在髋、膝和踝关节进行评估。采用Spearman相关分析检验本体感觉与步态能力之间的关系。两组在视觉受限下均行走更慢、步幅更短；然而，UMN病变患儿表现出更大的变化（p < 0.001）。在这些患儿中，本体感觉模态与步态参数显示弱至中度相关，且在视觉限制下相关性增强，这一模式在汇总分析中观察到。JMS与相对步行速度的相关性最强，但仍为弱相关。关节特异性分析显示，UMN病变患儿中相关性最强的是更受影响的踝关节和较少受影响的髋关节。UMN病变患儿在视觉受限下步行更依赖本体感觉输入，较少受影响的髋关节和更受影响的踝关节可能代偿缺陷。针对本体感觉的干预可能增强在不同感觉条件下的步行表现。
items.frontierRationale: 新近研究聚焦视觉-本体感觉交互对步行能力的影响，虽非ALS直接研究，但为理解上运动神经元病变相关感觉运动整合及康复靶点提供了转化线索。

items.title: Expanding Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Genetic Spectrum via Systematic Screening of Adult-Onset Neurologic Disease Genes.
items.summary: Emerging evidence indicates that amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) shares genetic architecture with other neurologic disorders, whose causal variants may be overlooked by targeted sequencing. Here, we evaluated the occurrence of pathogenic variants in genes linked to adult-onset neurologic disorders among individuals with ALS. Short-read WGS was performed in retrospectively collected ALS (Gold Coast criteria) and primary lateral sclerosis (PLS) (consensus diagnostic criteria) patients consecutively recruited at an Italian tertiary referral center (2013-2023), extensively phenotyped to exclude mimics. Pathogenic or likely pathogenic single-nucleotide variants/indels (American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics guidelines) and short tandem repeat expansions across 453 genes, including established ALS genes and other neurodegenerative disease genes, were systematically screened and validated. C9orf72 expansions (>30 repeats) were routinely screened by fragment analysis and repeat-primed PCR. A total of 856 patients with ALS and PLS (median age at onset 61.8 years, 38.5% women) were enrolled. Among them, 168 (19.6%) carried pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants or short tandem repeat expansions in genes associated with adult-onset neurologic disorders, mostly autosomal dominant. Of these, 41 (4.8% of the cohort) harbored variants in non-ALS/frontotemporal dementia (FTD) genes (ataxias, neuropathies, myopathies, movement disorders, mitochondrial diseases, and hereditary spastic paraplegia [HSP]). Repeat expansions accounted for 11.9% of cases, while 0.6% carried both sequence variants and repeat expansions. Family history of ALS/FTD ( p = 2.132e-06), other neurodegenerative disorders ( p = 0.0006934), and earlier age at onset ( p = 0.024) were enriched among variant carriers. Variants in genes associated with upper motor neuron (UMN) involvement (ataxias/HSP) did not predict an UMN-predominant phenotype (odds ratio 1.54, 95% CI 0.39-6.07, p = 0.54), while the association between neuropathy/myopathy genes and a lower motor neuron-predominant phenotype was not statistically estimable. Beyond established ALS pathways, enrichment was observed in mitochondrial, metabolic, and proteostasis pathways (false discovery rate ≤0.05). Although the absence of a control cohort limits assessment of variant enrichment, the identification of pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in genes associated with adult-onset neurologic disorders other than ALS/FTD in patients with ALS supports the inclusion of broader gene panels to advance precision medicine in ALS.
items.titleZh: 通过系统筛查成人起病神经系统疾病基因拓展肌萎缩侧索硬化遗传谱
items.summaryZh: 这项在856例ALS和PLS患者中开展的全基因组测序研究系统筛查了453个基因，发现19.6%的患者携带与成人起病神经系统疾病相关的致病或可能致病变异，其中4.8%涉及非ALS/FTD基因（如共济失调、神经病、肌病、线粒体病和HSP基因）。重复扩增占11.9%。携带者更常有ALS/FTD或其他神经退行性疾病家族史，且发病年龄更早。研究还发现线粒体、代谢和蛋白稳态通路富集。作者认为，ALS基因检测面板应适当扩展，以支持精准医学。
items.insight: 该研究提示，相当比例的ALS患者携带传统ALS/FTD面板之外的神经遗传病基因变异，这对临床基因检测策略、遗传咨询和表型分类具有直接意义。尤其值得关注的是，这些“非经典”变异可能影响临床试验入组分层和靶向治疗选择；同时，线粒体、代谢和蛋白稳态通路的富集为机制研究提供了新线索。

aiRead.studyType: 回顾性观察性队列研究，单中心，短读长全基因组测序，无对照队列
aiRead.keyFinding: 19.6%的ALS/PLS患者携带成人起病神经系统疾病相关基因的致病或可能致病变异，其中4.8%涉及非ALS/FTD基因；重复扩增占11.9%；携带者家族史更丰富且发病更早。
aiRead.limitation: 缺乏对照队列，无法评估变异富集程度；神经病/肌病基因与下运动神经元表型的关联无法进行统计学估计；单中心回顾性设计可能限制外推性。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续需在对照队列中验证这些非经典基因变异的富集与致病贡献，并评估扩展基因面板对ALS精准医学、遗传咨询和临床试验分层的影响。

items.abstractZh: 新出现的证据表明，肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）与其他神经系统疾病共享遗传架构，其致病性变异可能被靶向测序所遗漏。本研究评估了ALS个体中与成人起病神经系统疾病相关基因的致病性变异发生情况。对2013至2023年间在意大利一家三级转诊中心连续招募的ALS（Gold Coast标准）和原发性侧索硬化（PLS）（共识诊断标准）患者进行回顾性收集，并开展短读长全基因组测序，患者经过广泛表型分析以排除模拟疾病。系统筛查并验证了453个基因中的致病性或可能致病性单核苷酸变异/插入缺失（美国医学遗传学与基因组学学会指南）及短串联重复扩增，包括已知ALS基因和其他神经退行性疾病基因。C9orf72扩增（>30次重复）通过片段分析和重复引物PCR常规筛查。共纳入856例ALS和PLS患者（发病中位年龄61.8岁，女性占38.5%）。其中，168例（19.6%）携带与成人起病神经系统疾病相关基因的致病性或可能致病性变异或短串联重复扩增，大多为常染色体显性。其中41例（占队列4.8%）携带非ALS/额颞叶痴呆（FTD）基因的变异（共济失调、神经病、肌病、运动障碍、线粒体疾病和遗传性痉挛性截瘫[HSP]）。重复扩增占病例的11.9%，而0.6%同时携带序列变异和重复扩增。变异携带者中富集ALS/FTD家族史（p = 2.132e-06）、其他神经退行性疾病家族史（p = 0.0006934）和较早发病年龄（p = 0.024）。与上运动神经元（UMN）受累相关的基因（共济失调/HSP）变异不能预测UMN为主表型（比值比1.54，95% CI 0.39-6.07，p = 0.54），而神经病/肌病基因与下运动神经元为主表型之间的关联无法进行统计学估计。除已知ALS通路外，还观察到线粒体、代谢和蛋白稳态通路的富集（错误发现率≤0.05）。尽管缺乏对照队列限制了对变异富集的评估，但在ALS患者中鉴定出与ALS/FTD以外的成人起病神经系统疾病相关基因的致病性或可能致病性变异，支持纳入更广泛的基因面板以推进ALS精准医学。
items.frontierRationale: 基于大规模ALS队列的全基因组系统筛查，新近揭示了传统ALS/FTD基因面板之外的可观遗传负担，对ALS精准诊断和试验分层具有转化价值。

items.title: Robustness of Plasma P-Tau217 Diagnostic Thresholds for Alzheimer Disease Across Various Clinical Populations and Laboratory Environments.
items.summary: Blood-based biomarkers (BBMs), especially plasma tau phosphorylated at threonine 217 (p-tau217), could scale Alzheimer disease (AD) clinical-biological diagnosis, but clinical use requires thresholds transferable across laboratories and populations. We compared Lumipulse p-tau217 with other BBMs; evaluated amyloid-anchored thresholds across centers, analyzers, reagent lots, and clinical populations; and assessed second-line CSF adjudication of gray zone results. This multicenter, cross-sectional diagnostic-classification study included an exploratory Brussels cohort and 3 external validation cohorts. Brussels participants were cognitively unimpaired or impaired and had Aβ status determined by amyloid-PET or CSF Aβ42 and tau status by tau-PET or CSF p-tau181. Validation cohorts comprised consecutive Paris memory-clinic patients, patients with early-onset neurodegenerative dementia in Bordeaux, and individuals with monogenic frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD). Plasma p-tau217 was measured locally on Lumipulse analyzers. BBMs and ratios were compared using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses. In Brussels, a Youden cutoff and dual 95% or 97.5% sensitivity/specificity cutoffs were derived; intermediate values defined gray zones. Among 411 participants (mean age 70.5 years; 51.6% female), p-tau217 showed the best diagnostic performance; p-tau217/Aβ42 did not improve performance or reduce gray zones. In Brussels, p-tau217 discriminated Aβ+ from Aβ- status (AUC 0.96, 95% CI 0.93-0.98; p < 0.0001). The 0.193 pg/mL Youden cutoff (95% CI 0.178-0.213) yielded 91.5% sensitivity (95% CI 84.7-95.5) and 91.6% specificity (95% CI 84.8-95.5) and detected neocortical tau-PET positivity with 98.5% sensitivity and 81.8% specificity. In Paris, sensitivity/specificity for clinical-biological AD were 93.2% (95% CI 85.1-97.1)/93.0% (95% CI 81.4-97.6); in Bordeaux, sensitivity/specificity for clinical-biological AD were 95.7% (95% CI 79.0-99.2)/92.3% (95% CI 66.7-98.6). Specificity in monogenic FTLD was 88.4% (95% CI 75.5-94.9). False-positive classifications were enriched in FTLD with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Dual thresholds yielded gray zones in 15.4%-24.8% of Paris patients; second-line CSF testing resolved 86.2%-88.9% of gray zone cases. Lumipulse plasma p-tau217 thresholds were transferable across centers, analyzers, reagent lots, and heterogeneous clinical populations, supporting evaluation of plasma-first pathways with confirmatory testing for gray zone values. Values below 0.193 pg/mL made neocortical tauopathy unlikely. Limitations include cross-sectional design, specialized Western European recruitment, unavailable race/ethnicity data, heterogeneous reference standards, incomplete AD copathology adjudication in monogenic FTLD, and no cross-platform comparison.
items.titleZh: 血浆P-Tau217诊断阈值在多种临床人群和实验室环境中的稳健性
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心横断面诊断分类研究评估了Lumipulse血浆p-tau217在布鲁塞尔探索队列及巴黎、波尔多和单基因FTLD验证队列中的诊断阈值可转移性。p-tau217对Aβ状态区分能力最佳（AUC 0.96），0.193 pg/mL截断值在多个队列中保持较高敏感度和特异度；双阈值产生的灰区可通过二线CSF检测大部分裁定。值得注意的是，合并ALS的FTLD患者中假阳性分类富集，提示ALS人群解读p-tau217时需谨慎。
items.insight: 该研究直接涉及ALS相关鉴别诊断问题：合并ALS的FTLD患者更容易出现血浆p-tau217假阳性，提示在ALS队列中应用AD血液标志物时需考虑共病理和阈值解释。同时，其跨中心、跨分析仪和跨试剂批次的阈值稳健性验证，为ALS多中心生物标志物研究的标准化提供了方法学参考。

aiRead.studyType: 多中心横断面诊断分类研究（探索队列+3个外部验证队列）
aiRead.keyFinding: Lumipulse血浆p-tau217的0.193 pg/mL阈值在多个中心、分析仪、试剂批次和临床人群中可转移，AUC达0.96；合并ALS的FTLD患者中假阳性分类富集。
aiRead.limitation: 横断面设计、西欧专门招募、缺乏种族/民族数据、参考标准异质性、单基因FTLD中AD共病理裁定不完整、无跨平台比较。
aiRead.watchNext: 需在ALS和FTLD队列中进一步评估p-tau217假阳性的病理基础，并开展跨平台前瞻性验证及血浆优先路径的临床影响研究。

items.abstractZh: 血液生物标志物（BBMs），尤其是血浆苏氨酸217磷酸化tau蛋白（p-tau217），有望推广阿尔茨海默病（AD）的临床-生物学诊断，但临床应用需要可在不同实验室和人群间转移的阈值。我们比较了Lumipulse p-tau217与其他BBMs；评估了以淀粉样蛋白为锚定的阈值在不同中心、分析仪、试剂批次和临床人群间的表现；并评估了灰区结果的二线脑脊液（CSF）裁定。这项多中心、横断面诊断分类研究包括一个探索性布鲁塞尔队列和3个外部验证队列。布鲁塞尔参与者认知正常或受损，其Aβ状态由淀粉样蛋白PET或CSF Aβ42确定，tau状态由tau-PET或CSF p-tau181确定。验证队列包括巴黎记忆门诊连续患者、波尔多早发性神经退行性痴呆患者以及单基因额颞叶变性（FTLD）个体。血浆p-tau217在本地Lumipulse分析仪上检测。使用受试者工作特征（ROC）分析比较BBMs及其比值。在布鲁塞尔，推导了Youden截断值以及95%或97.5%敏感度/特异度双截断值；中间值定义为灰区。在411名参与者中（平均年龄70.5岁；51.6%女性），p-tau217显示出最佳诊断性能；p-tau217/Aβ42未改善性能或减少灰区。在布鲁塞尔，p-tau217可区分Aβ+与Aβ-状态（AUC 0.96，95% CI 0.93-0.98；p < 0.0001）。0.193 pg/mL的Youden截断值（95% CI 0.178-0.213）产生91.5%敏感度（95% CI 84.7-95.5）和91.6%特异度（95% CI 84.8-95.5），并以98.5%敏感度和81.8%特异度检出新皮质tau-PET阳性。在巴黎，临床-生物学AD的敏感度/特异度为93.2%（95% CI 85.1-97.1）/93.0%（95% CI 81.4-97.6）；在波尔多，临床-生物学AD的敏感度/特异度为95.7%（95% CI 79.0-99.2）/92.3%（95% CI 66.7-98.6）。单基因FTLD中的特异度为88.4%（95% CI 75.5-94.9）。假阳性分类在合并肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的FTLD中富集。双阈值在15.4%-24.8%的巴黎患者中产生灰区；二线CSF检测解决了86.2%-88.9%的灰区病例。Lumipulse血浆p-tau217阈值可在中心、分析仪、试剂批次和异质性临床人群间转移，支持评估血浆优先路径并对灰区值进行确认检测。低于0.193 pg/mL的值使新皮质tau病变不太可能。局限性包括横断面设计、西欧专门招募、缺乏种族/民族数据、参考标准异质性、单基因FTLD中AD共病理裁定不完整以及无跨平台比较。
items.frontierRationale: 新近多中心验证显示血浆p-tau217阈值可跨实验室转移，并揭示合并ALS的FTLD患者假阳性富集，对ALS相关AD共病理鉴别具有转化价值。

items.title: Health-Related Quality of Life Across Neurologic Conditions: A Cross-Sectional Cohort Study Using Real-World Patient-Reported Outcomes.
items.summary: Health-related quality of life (HRQOL) is an important outcome within value-based care for patients with neurologic conditions. The American Academy of Neurology recommends the use of Patient-Reported Outcomes Measurement Information System (PROMIS) Global Health as a patient-reported outcome performance measure to assess stability or improvement over 1 year. However, interpretation of this measure requires an understanding of HRQOL across neurologic populations. Our study leveraged real-world data collected through the electronic health record to characterize differences in HRQOL across common neurologic conditions. This is a cross-sectional study of adult patients with 1 of 10 conditions (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis [ALS], back pain, brain tumor, dementia, major depression, epilepsy, migraine, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson disease, and stroke) who completed patient-reported outcomes as standard care between October 2015 and March 2023 at a large Neurologic Institute. Patients completed PROMIS-GH, from which physical and mental summary scores (Global Mental Health [GMH], Global Physical Health [GPH]) were calculated, PHQ-9 depression screen, and condition-specific measures. EQ-5D utility index was estimated from PROMIS-GH. These were summarized across conditions after adjustment for demographics, clinical characteristics, and self-reported condition-specific severity. There were 133,636 patients included in this analysis (mean age 51.5 [SD ± 18] years, 64% female, 81% White race). Overall adjusted average scores for GPH, GMH, PHQ-9, and EQ-5D were 42.7 ± 5.0, 43.6 ± 5.0, 7.9 ± 3.7, and 0.68 ± 0.11, respectively. Scores were significantly different across condition, with GPH ranging from 39.6 ± 5.5 for back pain to 45.9 ± 3.9 for brain tumor. Patients with brain tumor, back pain, stroke, ALS, and multiple sclerosis had more favorable GMH and PHQ-9 scores, while patients with depression, epilepsy, and dementia had the most affected GMH and PHQ-9 scores. Patients with back pain and headache had the lowest EQ-5D scores (0.63 ± 0.13 and 0.67 ± 0.09), while those with brain tumor had the highest (0.77 ± 0.08). This study provides condition-specific and severity-specific benchmarks for PROMIS-GH and related HRQOL measures that can support interpretation of patient-reported outcomes across neurologic populations. These data inform clinical care, quality measurement, research, and the implementation of the AAN-recommended performance measure.

items.titleZh: 神经系统疾病中的健康相关生活质量：一项使用真实世界患者报告结局的横断面队列研究
items.summaryZh: 该横断面研究基于一家大型神经病学研究所2015-2023年的电子健康记录真实世界数据，纳入133,636例成人患者，覆盖ALS、背痛、脑肿瘤、痴呆、抑郁、癫痫、偏头痛、多发性硬化、帕金森病和卒中10种神经系统疾病。研究比较了PROMIS全球健康量表（GPH、GMH）、PHQ-9和EQ-5D在各类疾病中的调整后评分，发现不同疾病间HRQOL存在显著差异，并给出了按疾病和严重程度分层的基准值。ALS患者被纳入分析，其GMH和PHQ-9评分相对较有利，但该研究为观察性横断面设计，不能推断因果或疗效。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS提供了一个来自大规模真实世界数据的HRQOL基准参照，有助于ALS研究者在临床试验和临床照护中解读PROMIS-GH等患者报告结局，并支持AAN推荐绩效指标在ALS人群中的落地应用；但需注意其为横断面观察性研究，不能用于评估治疗效应。

aiRead.keyFinding: 不同神经系统疾病间PROMIS-GH、PHQ-9和EQ-5D评分存在显著差异，研究提供了按疾病和严重程度调整后的HRQOL基准值；ALS患者GMH和PHQ-9评分相对较有利，但EQ-5D等指标需结合具体数据解读。
aiRead.limitation: 横断面设计无法推断因果或纵向变化；样本以白人、女性为主，单中心数据可能限制外推性；ALS亚组的具体样本量和评分未在摘要中单独报告。

items.abstractZh: 健康相关生活质量（HRQOL）是神经系统疾病患者价值导向医疗中的重要结局指标。美国神经病学学会推荐使用患者报告结局测量信息系统（PROMIS）全球健康量表作为患者报告结局绩效指标，以评估1年内的稳定性或改善情况。然而，解读该指标需要了解不同神经病人群中的HRQOL状况。本研究利用通过电子健康记录收集的真实世界数据，描述常见神经系统疾病之间HRQOL的差异。这是一项横断面研究，纳入在2015年10月至2023年3月期间于一家大型神经病学研究所作为标准诊疗完成患者报告结局的成人患者，涵盖10种疾病之一（肌萎缩侧索硬化[ALS]、背痛、脑肿瘤、痴呆、重度抑郁、癫痫、偏头痛、多发性硬化、帕金森病和卒中）。患者完成PROMIS-GH，并据此计算身体和心理健康综合评分（全球心理健康[GMH]、全球身体健康[GPH]）、PHQ-9抑郁筛查以及疾病特异性量表。EQ-5D效用指数由PROMIS-GH估算。在调整人口学特征、临床特征和自我报告的疾病特异性严重程度后，对这些指标按疾病进行汇总。本分析共纳入133,636例患者（平均年龄51.5[SD ± 18]岁，64%女性，81%白人）。GPH、GMH、PHQ-9和EQ-5D的总体调整平均评分分别为42.7 ± 5.0、43.6 ± 5.0、7.9 ± 3.7和0.68 ± 0.11。不同疾病间评分存在显著差异，GPH从背痛的39.6 ± 5.5到脑肿瘤的45.9 ± 3.9不等。脑肿瘤、背痛、卒中、ALS和多发性硬化患者的GMH和PHQ-9评分较为有利，而抑郁、癫痫和痴呆患者的GMH和PHQ-9评分受影响最大。背痛和头痛患者的EQ-5D评分最低（0.63 ± 0.13和0.67 ± 0.09），而脑肿瘤患者最高（0.77 ± 0.08）。本研究为PROMIS-GH及相关HRQOL指标提供了按疾病和严重程度分层的基准值，可支持跨神经病人群患者报告结局的解读。这些数据可为临床诊疗、质量测量、研究以及AAN推荐绩效指标的实施提供信息。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2015-2023年真实世界电子健康记录，首次在包括ALS在内的10种神经系统疾病中建立PROMIS-GH及相关HRQOL指标的疾病与严重程度分层基准，具有直接的ALS患者报告结局解读与转化应用价值。

items.title: Sephin1 protects from glutamate stress, consistent with negative allosteric modulation of GluN2B-containing NMDA receptor.
items.summary: Glutamate excitotoxicity and GluN2B containing N-methyl-d-aspartate receptors (NMDARs) are involved in neurodegenerative diseases such as Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis, Parkinson disease and Alzheimer disease. Recently, Sephin1, a first-in-class, multi-functional, brain-penetrant, orally administered small molecule, has been demonstrated in vitro to improve motor neurons survival following glutamate intoxication. In ALS animal models, Sephin1 was able to reduce motor neuron loss, to improve motor function and increase animal survival. To determine how Sephin1 can reduce motor neurons loss following glutamate intoxication, calcium flux was measured in primary cortical neurons and in GluN1A/GluN2B overexpressing cells following NMDA stimulation. Then, to determine the binding site on GluN1 and GluN2B subunits, binding assays were performed with three benzylideneaminoguanidine derivatives, Sephin1, guanabenz and IFB-048. Here, for the first time, we show that Sephin1 reduces calcium flux in NMDA stimulated primary cortical neurons in a dose dependent manner. Sephin1, guanabenz and IFB-048 reduce the rise of calcium flux in GluN1A/GluN2B subunits overexpressing cells stimulated with NMDA. In addition, we demonstrated that Sephin1, guanabenz and IFB-048, displace ifenprodil from the N-terminal domain (NTD) of NMDAR (GluN1/GluN2B) containing the polyamine site on GluN2B subunits. The three benzylideneaminoguanidine derivatives could possibly be Negative Allosteric Modulator (NAM) of GluN2B-containing NMDARs.
items.titleZh: Sephin1 对谷氨酸应激具有保护作用，与对含 GluN2B 的 NMDA 受体的负向变构调节一致
items.summaryZh: 该研究在细胞层面探索 Sephin1 减轻谷氨酸兴奋性毒性的机制：Sephin1 可剂量依赖性地降低 NMDA 刺激引起的原代皮层神经元钙内流，并在过表达 GluN1A/GluN2B 的细胞中抑制钙流升高；结合实验提示 Sephin1、胍那苄和 IFB-048 可能作用于含 GluN2B 的 NMDA 受体 N 端结构域的多胺位点，发挥负向变构调节作用。这为解释 Sephin1 在 ALS 动物模型中保护运动神经元提供了可能的机制线索，但研究仍属细胞与分子层面，尚未提供临床疗效证据。
items.insight: Sephin1 已在 ALS 动物模型中显示减少运动神经元丢失和延长生存，本研究进一步给出其可能的作用靶点——含 GluN2B 的 NMDA 受体负向变构调节，有助于把 Sephin1 的神经保护作用与谷氨酸兴奋性毒性通路联系起来。对 ALS 研究者而言，这提示可围绕 GluN2B-NMDAR 变构调节开展靶点验证和生物标志物探索，但需注意目前仅为细胞实验，不能据此推断临床获益。

aiRead.studyType: 体外细胞与分子机制研究（原代皮层神经元钙流测定及受体结合实验）
aiRead.keyFinding: Sephin1 剂量依赖性降低 NMDA 诱导的原代皮层神经元钙流，并与胍那苄、IFB-048 一样抑制 GluN1A/GluN2B 过表达细胞的钙流升高、置换 NMDAR N 端结构域的艾芬地尔，提示其为含 GluN2B 的 NMDAR 负向变构调节剂。
aiRead.limitation: 仅为细胞和分子层面实验，缺乏在体 ALS 模型中的直接机制验证和临床数据，不能说明疗效。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续需在 ALS 动物模型和临床前毒理/药代研究中验证 GluN2B-NMDAR 负向变构调节是否介导 Sephin1 的神经保护作用，并关注其临床开发进展。

items.abstractZh: 谷氨酸兴奋性毒性和含 GluN2B 的 N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸受体（NMDARs）参与肌萎缩侧索硬化、帕金森病和阿尔茨海默病等神经退行性疾病。近期，Sephin1——一种首创的、多功能的、可透过血脑屏障的口服小分子——已在体外被证明可改善谷氨酸中毒后的运动神经元存活。在 ALS 动物模型中，Sephin1 能够减少运动神经元丢失、改善运动功能并提高动物生存率。为确定 Sephin1 如何减少谷氨酸中毒后的运动神经元丢失，研究者在原代皮层神经元和过表达 GluN1A/GluN2B 的细胞中，于 NMDA 刺激后测量了钙流。随后，为确定其在 GluN1 和 GluN2B 亚基上的结合位点，研究者用三种苄叉氨基胍衍生物——Sephin1、胍那苄和 IFB-048——进行了结合实验。本文首次显示，Sephin1 以剂量依赖方式降低 NMDA 刺激的原代皮层神经元中的钙流。Sephin1、胍那苄和 IFB-048 可降低经 NMDA 刺激的过表达 GluN1A/GluN2B 亚基细胞中钙流的升高。此外，我们证明 Sephin1、胍那苄和 IFB-048 可将艾芬地尔从含 GluN2B 亚基上多胺位点的 NMDAR（GluN1/GluN2B）N 端结构域（NTD）置换出来。这三种苄叉氨基胍衍生物可能是含 GluN2B 的 NMDARs 的负向变构调节剂（NAM）。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示 Sephin1 可能通过负向变构调节含 GluN2B 的 NMDA 受体减轻谷氨酸应激，为 ALS 中谷氨酸兴奋性毒性干预提供了可转化的机制线索。

items.title: Limited contribution of natural killer cells to SOD1 G93A ALS pathogenesis: evidence from comprehensive immunophenotyping and genetic deletion of Ncr1 and Properdin .
items.summary: Immune dysregulation contributes to amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) pathogenesis. Natural killer (NK) lymphocytes have been proposed to contribute to ALS, but their exact role remains debated. Here we combined comprehensive immunophenotyping strategy with two complementary loss-of-function approaches to trace NK cells and assess their Ncr1-associated cytotoxic function in SOD1 G93A mice. We found no significant difference in the proportion, maturation, and activation status of circulating NK cells between control and SOD1 G93A mice at onset and symptomatic stage, and no significant NK cell recruitment to the central nervous system at any disease stage. Notably, resident microglia in the SOD1 G93A spinal cord acquire NK1.1 expression at the symptomatic stage. NK cells isolated from SOD1 G93A mice did not affect motoneuron survival in vitro . We further show that genetic deletion of Ncr1 , which abolishes one of the major activating pathways of NK-cell cytotoxicity, did not modify disease onset, motor function or survival of SOD1 G93A mice. Additionally, we show that Properdin, a positive regulator of the alternative complement pathway and a reported ligand of NCR1, decorates misfolded SOD1 inclusions and degenerating astrocytes, consistent with a role as a phagocytic signal for CD68 + microglia. However, genetic deletion of Properdin in SOD1 G93A did not influence neuroinflammation or motoneuron survival. Together, the unchanged frequency, maturation or activation status of NK cells, combined with the lack of effect of Ncr1 genetic ablation argue against a major NK contribution to motoneuron degeneration in the SOD1 G93A mouse model, while uncovering an unexpected role for Properdin in opsonizing misfolded SOD1 aggregates.
items.titleZh: 自然杀伤细胞对SOD1 G93A型ALS发病机制的贡献有限：来自全面免疫表型分析和Ncr1与Properdin基因缺失的证据
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1 G93A ALS小鼠模型中系统追踪NK细胞，发现其数量、成熟度、活化状态及向中枢神经系统的募集均无显著变化；敲除NK细胞主要活化受体Ncr1不影响疾病发病、运动功能或生存；体外NK细胞也不影响运动神经元存活。研究不支持NK细胞在该模型中驱动运动神经元变性。另一方面，补体调控因子Properdin可标记错误折叠SOD1聚集体和退变星形胶质细胞，但敲除Properdin同样不影响神经炎症和运动神经元存活。
items.insight: 这项研究以多种功能缺失策略对“NK细胞参与ALS”的假说进行了较系统的检验，结果偏向阴性，有助于研究者避免将NK细胞作为SOD1 G93A模型中的核心致病靶点；同时提示小胶质细胞在症状期获得NK1.1标记，可能干扰基于该标记的细胞归属判断。Properdin与错误折叠SOD1聚集体的关联则为补体介导的清除机制提供了新的观察线索，值得在其它ALS模型中验证。

aiRead.studyType: 动物/细胞实验（SOD1 G93A小鼠模型，结合免疫表型分析及Ncr1、Properdin基因缺失）
aiRead.keyFinding: NK细胞比例、成熟度、活化及中枢募集无显著变化，Ncr1缺失不改变SOD1 G93A小鼠疾病进程；Properdin可标记错误折叠SOD1聚集体，但其缺失不影响神经炎症或运动神经元存活。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅基于SOD1 G93A小鼠模型和体外实验，不能直接外推至人类ALS或其它遗传亚型；NK细胞作用为阴性结论，需注意模型与时间窗的局限。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注Properdin调理错误折叠SOD1聚集体的后续机制研究，以及在其他ALS模型或人源体系中验证NK细胞与小胶质细胞NK1.1表达的归属和功能。

items.abstractZh: 免疫失调参与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的发病机制。自然杀伤（NK）淋巴细胞被认为可能参与ALS，但其确切作用仍存争议。本研究将全面的免疫表型分析策略与两种互补的功能缺失方法相结合，以追踪SOD1 G93A小鼠中的NK细胞，并评估其与Ncr1相关的细胞毒功能。我们发现，在发病期和症状期，对照小鼠与SOD1 G93A小鼠之间循环NK细胞的比例、成熟度和活化状态均无显著差异，且在任何疾病阶段均未观察到NK细胞显著募集至中枢神经系统。值得注意的是，SOD1 G93A小鼠脊髓中的驻留小胶质细胞在症状期获得NK1.1表达。从SOD1 G93A小鼠分离的NK细胞在体外不影响运动神经元存活。我们进一步表明，基因缺失Ncr1（该缺失消除了NK细胞细胞毒性的主要激活通路之一）并未改变SOD1 G93A小鼠的疾病发病、运动功能或生存。此外，我们显示Properdin——替代补体通路的正调控因子及据报道的NCR1配体——装饰错误折叠的SOD1包涵体和退变星形胶质细胞，这与作为CD68+小胶质细胞吞噬信号的作用一致。然而，在SOD1 G93A中基因缺失Properdin并未影响神经炎症或运动神经元存活。总之，NK细胞频率、成熟度或活化状态未变，加之Ncr1基因消融缺乏效应，反对NK对SOD1 G93A小鼠模型运动神经元变性有主要贡献，同时揭示了Properdin在调理错误折叠SOD1聚集体中的意外作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究以遗传缺失和全面免疫表型分析近期重新审视NK细胞在SOD1 G93A ALS模型中的作用，并揭示Properdin调理错误折叠SOD1的新机制，对ALS神经免疫靶点优先级判断具有转化参考价值。

items.title: Combined γ-oryzanol and α-lipoic acid treatment suppresses inflammation and apoptosis in hSOD1 G93A models of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis via the AKT/GSK3β pathway.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease with complex pathogenic mechanisms, and the efficacy of single-target interventions remains limited. γ-Oryzanol (Orz) and α-lipoic acid (ALA) exert neuroprotective effects individually, yet their combined effects and molecular mechanisms in ALS remain unclear. To investigate the therapeutic effects and mechanisms of combined Orz and ALA treatment in ALS. Network pharmacology was used to identify potential targets shared by the compounds and ALS. Core targets and pathways were identified through protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis, molecular docking, and functional enrichment analysis, followed by experimental validation in hSOD1 G93A cell and transgenic mouse models. Six core targets (EGFR, AKT1, HSP90AA1, BCL2, SRC, HSP90AB1) were identified. In hSOD1 G93A cells, combined treatment modulated mRNA expression and protein phosphorylation of the core targets and attenuated cellular injury. In hSOD1 G93A transgenic mice, the combination delayed disease progression, prolonged survival, improved motor function, and reduced motor neuron loss. This combination alleviated inflammation and apoptosis by activating the AKT/GSK3β pathway. Combined Orz and ALA treatment modulates core targets, activates the AKT/GSK3β pathway, and suppresses inflammation and apoptosis. This combination represents a promising therapeutic strategy for ALS.
items.titleZh: γ-谷维素与α-硫辛酸联合治疗通过AKT/GSK3β通路抑制肌萎缩侧索硬化hSOD1 G93A模型中的炎症与凋亡
items.summaryZh: 该研究在网络药理学预测基础上，于hSOD1 G93A细胞和转基因小鼠中验证γ-谷维素与α-硫辛酸联合治疗的效应：联合处理可调节EGFR、AKT1、BCL2等核心靶点，激活AKT/GSK3β通路，减轻炎症和凋亡；在小鼠中延缓疾病进展、延长生存并改善运动功能。研究属于临床前动物/细胞实验，尚不能说明对人体有效。
items.insight: 该研究把两种已有安全性基础的天然化合物组合与明确的ALS相关信号通路（AKT/GSK3β）及SOD1模型表型联系起来，为ALS联合干预策略提供了可验证的临床前依据；其网络药理学预测加细胞/小鼠验证的路径，也便于后续围绕核心靶点设计更严格的剂量、时程和机制特异性实验。

aiRead.studyType: 临床前研究：网络药理学分析结合hSOD1 G93A细胞与转基因小鼠实验
aiRead.keyFinding: 联合治疗调节EGFR、AKT1、HSP90AA1、BCL2、SRC、HSP90AB1等核心靶点，激活AKT/GSK3β通路，减轻炎症与凋亡；小鼠中延缓疾病进展、延长生存、改善运动功能并减少运动神经元丢失。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，致病机制复杂，单靶点干预的疗效仍然有限。γ-谷维素（Orz）与α-硫辛酸（ALA）各自具有神经保护作用，但二者联合在ALS中的效应及分子机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在探讨Orz与ALA联合治疗对ALS的治疗效应及机制。研究采用网络药理学识别两种化合物与ALS共享的潜在靶点，通过蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）网络分析、分子对接和功能富集分析确定核心靶点与通路，随后在hSOD1 G93A细胞及转基因小鼠模型中进行实验验证。共识别出6个核心靶点（EGFR、AKT1、HSP90AA1、BCL2、SRC、HSP90AB1）。在hSOD1 G93A细胞中，联合处理调节了核心靶点的mRNA表达与蛋白磷酸化，并减轻了细胞损伤。在hSOD1 G93A转基因小鼠中，联合治疗延缓疾病进展、延长生存期、改善运动功能并减少运动神经元丢失。该联合方案通过激活AKT/GSK3β通路减轻炎症与凋亡。结论：Orz与ALA联合治疗可调节核心靶点、激活AKT/GSK3β通路并抑制炎症与凋亡，该联合方案是ALS的一种有前景的治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 新近临床前研究在hSOD1 G93A模型中将γ-谷维素与α-硫辛酸联合治疗与AKT/GSK3β通路及疾病表型改善相关联，具有ALS转化研究价值。

items.title: Black Myrobalan ( Terminalia chebula ) as a potential multitarget neuroprotective agent: Translational insights and future directions in neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary: Myrobalan or Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula Retz. ) has been integrated into Ayurvedic, Unani, and even Tibetan medicine systems for over 2000 years. The "King of Medicines" has traditionally been used for diverse ailments such as digestive issues, wound healing, and general body strengthening. Now, modern medicine is focusing on the myrobalan's potential neuroprotective properties and its use in Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, Huntington's, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) neurodegenerative disorders. These ailments are characterized by some combination of enduring oxidative damage, mitochondrial dysfunction, neuroinflammation, irregular protein aggregation, and progressive neuron cell death. Most of the current treatment options revolve around addressing the symptoms of the diseases, which is insufficient as the underlying disease continues to progress. There is an urgent need to devise therapies that work simultaneously on multiple disease pathways. Some of the noted secondary metabolites in T. chebula include hydrolyzable tannins like chebulinic and chebulagic acid as well as corilagin. Others occur as phenolic acids such as gallic and ellagic acid and flavonoids quercetin and kaempferol. Moreover, glycosides, sterols, and a wide range of alkaloids are also present. A number of these compounds are known to possess multifunctional biological properties like scavenging ROS, activating Nrf2/ARE signaling, downregulating pro-inflammatory mediators through blockade of NF-κB, and exerting protective effects on the mitochondria, as well as modulating apoptosis via Bcl-2 and caspases. T. chebula extracts and some isolated compounds have also been shown to improve cognitive function, reduce neuroinflammation, and protect dopaminergic neurons, and ameliorate neurotoxic effects of amyloid-β or α-synuclein through in vitro and in vivo animal studies. A review of the contributions from the phytochemistry, mechanism of action, preclinical, translational, and adjunctive applications of Terminalia chebula in neurodegenerative disease therapy is presented here.

items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了传统药物诃子（Terminalia chebula）在神经退行性疾病中的潜在神经保护作用。文章指出诃子含有多类活性成分（如诃子酸、柯里拉京、没食子酸、槲皮素等），这些成分在临床前研究中显示出抗氧化、抗炎、保护线粒体、调节凋亡等多靶点作用；动物和细胞研究提示其可能改善认知、减少神经炎症并保护多巴胺能神经元。文章强调目前治疗多仅对症，亟需多通路干预策略，并讨论了诃子用于ALS等疾病的转化前景，但尚未提供临床疗效证据。

items.abstractZh: 诃子（Myrobalan 或 Haritaki，Terminalia chebula Retz.）已被纳入阿育吠陀、尤纳尼乃至藏医药体系超过2000年。这种“药物之王”传统上用于治疗消化问题、伤口愈合和全身强壮等多种疾病。如今，现代医学正关注诃子的潜在神经保护特性及其在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）等神经退行性疾病中的应用。这些疾病的特征表现为持续性氧化损伤、线粒体功能障碍、神经炎症、异常蛋白聚集和进行性神经元细胞死亡中的若干组合。目前大多数治疗方案围绕缓解疾病症状，这并不充分，因为 underlying 疾病仍在持续进展。迫切需要设计能同时作用于多条疾病通路的疗法。诃子中已注意到的一些次生代谢物包括可水解鞣质如诃子酸（chebulinic acid）和诃黎勒酸（chebulagic acid）以及柯里拉京（corilagin）。其他包括酚酸如没食子酸和鞣花酸，以及黄酮类槲皮素和山奈酚。此外，还含有糖苷、甾醇和多种生物碱。其中许多化合物已知具有多功能生物学特性，如清除ROS、激活Nrf2/ARE信号、通过阻断NF-κB下调促炎介质、对线粒体发挥保护作用，以及通过Bcl-2和caspase调节凋亡。诃子提取物和一些分离化合物在体外和体内动物研究中还显示可改善认知功能、减少神经炎症、保护多巴胺能神经元，并改善淀粉样蛋白β或α-突触核蛋白的神经毒性作用。本文综述了诃子在神经退行性疾病治疗中的植物化学、作用机制、临床前、转化和辅助应用方面的贡献。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近系统整合了诃子多靶点神经保护机制与ALS等神经退行性疾病的转化潜力，为天然产物辅助治疗研究提供了前沿线索，但尚属临床前证据。

items.title: Chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan 4 participates in the internalization of arginine-rich dipeptide repeat proteins.
items.summary: Microsatellite repeat expansion of the 5' GGGGCC 3' sequence in the C9orf72 gene is the most common monogenic form of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia. Dipeptide repeat proteins (DPRs) translated from the mutant allele can be detected in postmortem brains of afflicted individuals. The arginine containing peptides, poly proline-arginine (poly-PR) and poly glycine-arginine (poly-GR), are particularly noxious to cells. Both can undergo cell-to-cell transmission, but underlying mechanisms are not understood. We found rapid internalization and nucleolar localization of bath-applied hemagglutinin (HA) tagged poly-PR with twenty repeats (HA-PR 20 ) in cell lines and neurons. Small molecule and RNAi approaches implicated a temperature-dependent, fluid phase endocytosis mechanism for HA-PR 20 . We sought to identify DPR-related cell surface uptake factors using µMap high-resolution proximity labeling. DPR-iridium conjugates identified candidate cell-surface proteins which were interrogated in a secondary RNAi screen. Focusing on our strongest candidate, chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan 4 (CSPG4), we showed cellular uptake of HA-PR 20 is reduced by inhibition of glycosaminoglycan chain synthesis and knockdown or ablation of CSPG4. Knockdown of CSPG4 protected PR 20 -induced neuronal toxicity. Using a dual reporter system to interrogate in vitro neuron-to-neuron transmission of PR 50, we found PR 50 synthesized by one neuron readily spread to neighboring cells. Transmission was significantly reduced with CSPG4 knockdown. Similarly conditioned media from PR 50 or GR 50 expressing neurons contained transmissible protein that was internalized into neurons in a CSPG4-dependent manner. These results suggest CSPG4 participates in poly-PR/poly-GR internalization and transmission.

items.summaryZh: 该研究在细胞和神经元模型中探索C9orf72相关二肽重复蛋白（尤其是poly-PR和poly-GR）如何进入细胞并在神经元间传播。作者通过邻近标记和RNAi筛选发现细胞表面蛋白CSPG4是poly-PR内化的关键因子之一；抑制CSPG4可减少摄取并减轻PR20诱导的神经元毒性，还可降低PR50在神经元间的传递。

items.abstractZh: C9orf72基因5' GGGGCC 3'序列的微卫星重复扩增是肌萎缩侧索硬化症和额颞叶痴呆最常见的单基因形式。从突变等位基因翻译产生的二肽重复蛋白（DPRs）可在患者死后脑组织中检测到。含精氨酸的肽段，即聚脯氨酸-精氨酸（poly-PR）和聚甘氨酸-精氨酸（poly-GR），对细胞尤其有害。两者均可发生细胞间传递，但其潜在机制尚不清楚。我们发现，在细胞系和神经元中，外源施加的带有血凝素（HA）标签、含二十个重复的poly-PR（HA-PR20）可快速内化并定位于核仁。小分子和RNAi方法提示HA-PR20通过温度依赖的液相内吞机制进入细胞。我们试图利用µMap高分辨率邻近标记技术鉴定与DPR相关的细胞表面摄取因子。DPR-铱偶联物鉴定出候选细胞表面蛋白，并在二次RNAi筛选中对这些蛋白进行了验证。聚焦于最强的候选分子硫酸软骨素蛋白聚糖4（CSPG4），我们证明抑制糖胺聚糖链合成以及敲低或敲除CSPG4均可减少HA-PR20的细胞摄取。敲低CSPG4可保护PR20诱导的神经元毒性。利用双报告系统研究PR50在体外神经元间的传递，我们发现一个神经元合成的PR50可轻易扩散至邻近细胞。敲低CSPG4后传递显著减少。同样，来自表达PR50或GR50的神经元的条件培养基含有可传递的蛋白，其以CSPG4依赖的方式被内化进入神经元。这些结果提示CSPG4参与poly-PR/poly-GR的内化和传递。
items.frontierRationale: 新近鉴定了CSPG4作为C9orf72相关精氨酸二肽重复蛋白内化和神经元间传递的候选表面因子，具有ALS机制转化价值。

items.title: Brain-computer interfaces for neurodegenerative diseases: A comprehensive review of closed-loop systems from diagnosis to neural rehabilitation.
items.summary: Brain-computer interface (BCI) technology serves as an important bridge between the nervous system and external devices and has shown considerable promise for the diagnosis and treatment of neurodegenerative diseases, whose global burden continues to increase: in 2021, more than 57 million people were living with dementia worldwide, with Alzheimer's disease (AD) accounting for approximately 60-70% of cases, while an estimated 11.77 million people were living with Parkinson's disease (PD) in 2021, according to the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021. This growing disease burden, together with the progressive loss of cognitive, motor, and communicative functions, highlights the need for more precise approaches to early detection, functional assistance, and individualized intervention. Conventional diagnostic and therapeutic approaches remain poorly suited to early detection and timely intervention. This paper analyzes the development of BCI technology, from the first detection of electroencephalogram (EEG) signals to the parallel development of invasive and non-invasive systems, and outlines the basic principles of signal acquisition, processing, and decoding, together with the relative advantages and limitations of different approaches. It then focuses on the use of BCI in Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), covering early diagnosis, functional reconstruction, and neuromodulation. The article also discusses the difficulties encountered by BCI technology in terms of technological realization, clinical translation, and ethical considerations, as well as several future research directions, including multimodal fusion, adaptive algorithms, closed-loop control systems, and personalized treatment so as to drive the applications of BCI in precision medicine and in neurological diseases.

items.abstractZh: 脑机接口（BCI）技术是连接神经系统与外部设备的重要桥梁，在神经退行性疾病的诊断和治疗中展现出可观前景，而此类疾病的全球负担持续增加：据2021年全球疾病负担研究，2021年全球有超过5700万人患有痴呆症，其中阿尔茨海默病（AD）约占60-70%；2021年估计有1177万人患有帕金森病（PD）。疾病负担不断增长，加之认知、运动和交流功能的进行性丧失，凸显了对更精准的早期检测、功能辅助和个体化干预方法的需求。传统诊断和治疗方法仍难以满足早期检测和及时干预的需要。本文分析了BCI技术的发展历程，从首次检测到脑电图（EEG）信号到侵入式与非侵入式系统的并行发展，并概述了信号采集、处理和解码的基本原理，以及不同方法的相对优势和局限性。随后重点讨论BCI在阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中的应用，涵盖早期诊断、功能重建和神经调控。文章还讨论了BCI技术在技术实现、临床转化和伦理考量方面遇到的困难，以及若干未来研究方向，包括多模态融合、自适应算法、闭环控制系统和个体化治疗，以推动BCI在精准医学和神经系统疾病中的应用。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了闭环BCI在ALS等神经退行性疾病中从诊断到神经康复的转化路径，对评估BCI临床落地价值具有参考意义。

items.title: Optimized gGBE enables robust G-to-Y conversion in mammalian cells and zebrafish embryos.
items.summary: Base editing is a powerful and precise genome-editing tool capable of introducing single-base substitutions with high resolution. Depending on the base-modification domains employed, base editors can mediate both transition and transversion base editing in mammalian cells. While deaminase-derived base editors have enabled efficient transition editing in the zebrafish genome, glycosidase-derived transversion editing remains a significant challenge. In this study, guided by structural insights into the Cas9 complex, we engineered a series of glycosidase guanine base editor (gGBE) constructs by inlaying the N-methylpurine DNA glycosylase (MPG) domain into Cas9 protein. Among these variants, we identified a high-performance gGBE in which MPG was inserted between residues G1246 and S1247 of the PI domain in Streptococcus pyogenes Cas9, which we named gGBE-PIGS. This variant improved editing efficiency by up to 3.5-fold in mammalian cells and 13-fold in zebrafish embryos, without compromising editing precision. Furthermore, we developed a gGBE-editing-responsive GFP reporter to monitor editing efficiency and enrich for gGBE-edited cells and embryos. Using a combination of the optimized gGBE-PIGS and the GFP reporter, we successfully generated zebrafish models carrying mutations homologous to human amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS)-associated variants. items.title: Dual augmentation of STMN2 and GRN delays disease progression through coordinated axonal and neuroimmune support in ALS models.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder primarily driven by TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) proteinopathy, which triggers early axonal disintegration and disrupts central nervous system homeostasis. Current therapeutic options remain limited. To address these core pathologies, we developed a dual-gene therapeutic strategy that simultaneously restores two pivotal factors: progranulin (GRN), a multifunctional effector critical for lysosomal function and neuroinflammation regulation, and stathmin-2 (STMN2), an essential regulator of axonal integrity and regeneration whose loss is directly linked to TDP-43 pathology. In TDP-43 A315T transgenic mice, this combined therapy significantly extended survival, preserved motor performance, and maintained neuromuscular integrity. In human iPSC-derived motor neurons, the dual therapy promoted axonal regeneration following injury. Mechanistically, treatment coordinately restored axonal and synaptic gene programs in motor neurons while upregulating lysosomal pathways in microglia and neuronal support genes in astrocytes, collectively rebalancing neuronal and glial function. These findings establish that dual augmentation of GRN and STMN2 represents a potential therapeutic strategy for ALS.
items.titleZh: STMN2与GRN双重增强通过协调轴突和神经免疫支持延缓ALS模型疾病进展
items.summaryZh: 该研究在TDP-43 A315T转基因小鼠和人iPSC来源运动神经元中测试了同时增强GRN和STMN2的双基因策略。联合治疗延长了小鼠生存期、维持了运动功能和神经肌肉完整性，并在人运动神经元中促进轴突再生。机制上涉及运动神经元轴突/突触基因程序的恢复、小胶质细胞溶酶体通路的上调以及星形胶质细胞支持基因的上调。
items.insight: 该研究将TDP-43病理下游的两个关键节点——轴突完整性（STMN2）和溶酶体/神经免疫调节（GRN）——整合为单一联合策略，并在动物和人细胞模型中同时验证了生存获益与多细胞类型机制，为ALS的联合基因治疗提供了可跟踪的临床前概念验证。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，主要由TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）蛋白病变驱动，该病变触发早期轴突解体并破坏中枢神经系统稳态。当前治疗选择仍然有限。为针对这些核心病理，我们开发了一种双基因治疗策略，同时恢复两个关键因子：颗粒体蛋白前体（GRN），一种对溶酶体功能和神经炎症调节至关重要的多功能效应因子；以及stathmin-2（STMN2），一种对轴突完整性和再生至关重要的调节因子，其缺失与TDP-43病理直接相关。在TDP-43 A315T转基因小鼠中，该联合治疗显著延长了生存期、保持了运动性能并维持了神经肌肉完整性。在人iPSC来源的运动神经元中，双疗法促进了损伤后的轴突再生。机制上，治疗协调恢复了运动神经元中的轴突和突触基因程序，同时上调了小胶质细胞中的溶酶体通路和星形胶质细胞中的神经元支持基因，共同重新平衡了神经元和胶质细胞功能。这些发现确立了GRN和STMN2的双重增强代表了一种潜在的ALS治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年报道，针对ALS核心的TDP-43病理，在动物和人iPSC模型中验证了GRN与STMN2双重增强的转化潜力。

items.title: Non-pharmacological fatigue management strategies in neurodegenerative conditions: a scoping review.
items.summary: Fatigue is a common and disabling symptom across several neurodegenerative diseases, including multiple sclerosis and Parkinson's disease. Non-pharmacological strategies are widely used in clinical practice to address fatigue, yet the extent to which evidence from one neurodegenerative condition can inform fatigue management in others remains uncertain, particularly for Parkinson's disease where intervention trials are scarce. To map the quantitative evidence on non-pharmacological interventions for fatigue in adults with neurodegenerative diseases (excluding dementias), and to identify potentially transferable strategies, gaps, and priorities for research and practice, with particular relevance to Parkinson's disease. Scoping review conducted according to Joanna Briggs Institute guidance and reported using the PRISMA Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR). The protocol was preregistered on the Open Science Framework (OSF; DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/MJEYP). MEDLINE, Cochrane Library, CINAHL, AMED, and PsycINFO were searched for records published from January 2006 to 15 February 2025. Reference lists of relevant reviews and included studies were screened. Publications in English or Arabic were eligible. Quantitative interventional studies, mixed-methods studies with extractable quantitative fatigue outcomes, and systematic reviews/meta-analyses evaluating non-pharmacological interventions for fatigue in adults with progressive neurodegenerative conditions were eligible. Conditions of interest included multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, motor neurone disease, Huntington's disease, hereditary ataxias, multiple system atrophy, and progressive supranuclear palsy. Studies focusing solely on pharmacological, surgical, herbal, or homeopathic interventions, qualitative-only studies, and studies in dementias were excluded. A bespoke charting form captured study design, population, intervention, comparator, delivery format, fatigue measures, and key findings. Studies were grouped by intervention type: exercise, psychological, educational, and complementary interventions. Systematic reviews/meta-analyses and primary intervention studies were synthesized as distinct evidence levels and were not combined quantitatively. The search identified 12,618 records. After removal of 5,399 duplicates, 7,219 records were screened and 517 full-text articles were assessed for eligibility. Twenty-seven sources met the inclusion criteria: seven systematic reviews/meta-analyses, 16 randomized controlled trials, one non-randomized controlled study, and three uncontrolled pre-post studies. Evidence was dominated by multiple sclerosis, with only two small trials in Parkinson's disease and no fatigue-focused intervention trials in other progressive neurodegenerative conditions. The most consistent between-group benefits were observed for structured exercise, cognitive behavioral therapy, and educational/self-management programs in multiple sclerosis. Complementary interventions included acupuncture, light therapy, dietary interventions, and electrical stimulation; evidence across these approaches was mixed. Heterogeneity in intervention type, intensity, duration, supervision and delivery format, follow-up duration, and fatigue outcome measures limited direct comparison across studies. Non-pharmacological interventions for fatigue in neurodegenerative disease are most developed in multiple sclerosis, where structured exercise, cognitive behavioral therapy, and educational/self-management approaches show the most consistent benefit. Evidence for Parkinson's disease is sparse, and no fatigue-focused intervention trials were identified in other progressive neurodegenerative conditions. Future work should prioritize condition-specific feasibility and effectiveness studies, harmonized fatigue outcome sets, objective fatigability measures alongside patient-reported fatigue, and multimodal programs with clearly specified therapeutic targets. Fatigue can substantially affect daily life for people living with neurological conditions, but most research on non-drug fatigue management has been conducted in multiple sclerosis. This scoping review mapped 27 sources of evidence on exercise, psychological treatments, education or self-management, and complementary approaches. Structured exercise, cognitive behavioral therapy, and education or self-management showed the most consistent benefits in multiple sclerosis. Only two small fatigue-focused trials were identified in Parkinson’s disease, and no eligible fatigue-focused intervention trials were found in the other progressive neurodegenerative conditions included in the review. Some intervention components, such as pacing, self-monitoring, energy conservation, and graded activity, may be useful across conditions, but they may need adaptation for disease-specific motor, cognitive, autonomic, or progression-related needs. Studies also used many different fatigue measures, and objective fatigability was rarely assessed. Future research should test adapted interventions directly in under-represented conditions and use clearer, more consistent outcome measures.

items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中的非药物疲劳管理策略：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述系统梳理了神经退行性疾病（排除痴呆）中非药物疲劳干预的定量证据，共纳入27个来源。证据高度集中于多发性硬化症，结构化运动、认知行为疗法和教育/自我管理项目显示出最一致的获益；帕金森病仅有2项小型试验，其他进行性神经退行性疾病（包括运动神经元病）没有以疲劳为焦点的干预试验。综述还指出干预异质性大、疲劳测量工具不统一、客观疲劳易感性评估不足等问题，并建议未来开展疾病特异性研究、统一结局指标和验证可迁移的干预成分。
items.insight: 对ALS领域而言，这项综述明确暴露了一个关键空白：运动神经元病在非药物疲劳干预试验中完全缺位。疲劳是ALS患者常见且严重影响生活质量的症状，而多发性硬化症中已验证的结构化运动、认知行为疗法和自我管理策略可能具有迁移价值，但需要针对ALS的运动功能下降、呼吸受累和疾病进展速度进行调整。该综述为设计ALS特异性疲劳干预试验提供了证据地图和结局指标选择参考。

items.abstractZh: 疲劳是包括多发性硬化症和帕金森病在内的多种神经退行性疾病中常见且致残的症状。非药物策略在临床实践中被广泛用于应对疲劳，然而来自一种神经退行性疾病的证据在多大程度上能为其他疾病的疲劳管理提供参考仍不确定，尤其是对于干预试验稀缺的帕金森病。旨在梳理关于成人神经退行性疾病（排除痴呆）非药物干预疲劳的定量证据，并识别可能可迁移的策略、空白以及研究和实践的优先事项，特别关注帕金森病的相关性。按照乔安娜布里格斯研究所指南开展范围综述，并使用PRISMA范围综述扩展版（PRISMA-ScR）进行报告。方案已在开放科学框架（OSF；DOI：10.17605/OSF.IO/MJEYP）预注册。检索MEDLINE、Cochrane Library、CINAHL、AMED和PsycINFO中2006年1月至2025年2月15日发表的记录。筛选相关综述和纳入研究的参考文献列表。英文或阿拉伯文出版物符合条件。纳入标准为：定量干预研究、可提取定量疲劳结局的混合方法研究，以及评估成人进行性神经退行性疾病非药物疲劳干预的系统综述/荟萃分析。关注的疾病包括多发性硬化症、帕金森病、运动神经元病、亨廷顿病、遗传性共济失调、多系统萎缩和进行性核上性麻痹。仅关注药物、手术、草药或顺势疗法干预的研究、仅定性研究以及痴呆研究被排除。采用专门的数据提取表记录研究设计、人群、干预、对照、实施形式、疲劳测量指标和主要发现。研究按干预类型分组：运动、心理、教育和补充干预。系统综述/荟萃分析与原始干预研究作为不同证据级别分别综合，未进行定量合并。检索共识别12,618条记录。去除5,399条重复后，筛选7,219条记录，评估517篇全文的合格性。27个来源符合纳入标准：7篇系统综述/荟萃分析、16项随机对照试验、1项非随机对照研究和3项非对照前后研究。证据主要集中于多发性硬化症，帕金森病仅有2项小型试验，其他进行性神经退行性疾病中没有以疲劳为焦点的干预试验。在多发性硬化症中，结构化运动、认知行为疗法和教育/自我管理项目观察到最一致的组间获益。补充干预包括针灸、光照疗法、饮食干预和电刺激；这些方法的证据不一。干预类型、强度、持续时间、监督和实施形式、随访时长以及疲劳结局指标的异质性限制了研究间的直接比较。神经退行性疾病疲劳的非药物干预在多发性硬化症中最为成熟，结构化运动、认知行为疗法和教育/自我管理方法显示出最一致的获益。帕金森病的证据稀少，其他进行性神经退行性疾病中未识别到以疲劳为焦点的干预试验。未来工作应优先开展疾病特异性的可行性和有效性研究、统一的疲劳结局集、患者报告疲劳之外的客观疲劳易感性测量，以及治疗靶点明确规定的多模式项目。疲劳可显著影响神经系统疾病患者的日常生活，但大多数非药物疲劳管理研究是在多发性硬化症中进行的。本范围综述梳理了27个关于运动、心理治疗、教育或自我管理以及补充方法的证据来源。结构化运动、认知行为疗法和教育或自我管理在多发性硬化症中显示出最一致的获益。帕金森病中仅识别到两项小型以疲劳为焦点的试验，综述纳入的其他进行性神经退行性疾病中未发现符合条件的以疲劳为焦点的干预试验。某些干预成分，如节奏控制、自我监测、能量节约和分级活动，可能跨疾病有用，但可能需要针对疾病特异性运动、认知、自主神经或进展相关需求进行调整。研究还使用了多种不同的疲劳测量指标，且客观疲劳易感性很少被评估。未来研究应直接在代表性不足的疾病中测试经过调整的干预措施，并使用更清晰、更一致的结局指标。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近系统梳理了神经退行性疾病非药物疲劳干预证据，明确揭示运动神经元病等领域以疲劳为焦点的干预试验完全空白，为ALS疲劳管理的转化研究提供了直接的优先方向。
